title: Spatiotemporal Hyperedges for EEG Seizure Detection and Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.37730v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Seizure detection and prediction from EEG are clinically important but challenging because seizures are rare, temporally localized, and propagate as coordinated events across multiple channels. Recent dynamic graph neural networks model this by running a temporal model over a sequence of per-time-step pairwise channel edges. However, this pairwise construction misses the spatiotemporal coupling that constitutes a seizure, at substantial training cost. We propose HyBrain, which summarizes spatiotemporal EEG evidence through a small set of soft hyperedges rather than pairwise edges. A per-channel Mamba backbone produces one token per (channel, second), and a spatiotemporal hyperedge block pools these tokens into E_h shared group embeddings through soft memberships and broadcasts them back. The same encoder serves three downstream tasks: window-based detection, one-second point-wise detection, and preictal seizure prediction. On TUSZ and CH

translated_title: 用于脑电（EEG）癫痫发作检测与预测的时空超边
translated_abstract: 基于脑电图的癫痫发作检测与预测在临床上非常重要但充满挑战，因为癫痫发作较为罕见、在时间上局限于局部时段，并且会作为跨多个通道的协调事件进行传播。近期的动态图神经网络通过在逐时间步的成对通道边序列上运行时间模型来对此进行建模。然而，这种成对构建方式忽略了构成癫痫发作的时空耦合特性，且训练成本高昂。我们提出HyBrain，它通过一小组软超边而非成对边来总结时空脑电证据。每通道的Mamba骨干网络为每个（通道，秒）组合生成一个token，随后时空超边块通过软隶属关系将这些token池化为E_h个共享组嵌入，并将其广播回各通道。同一编码器可服务于三个下游任务：基于窗口的发作检测、逐秒点式发作检测以及发作前癫痫预测。在TUSZ和CH（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出HyBrain模型，利用少量时空软超边取代传统的成对通道边来建模脑电信号，以单一编码器统一完成癫痫发作的窗口检测、逐秒点式检测和发作前预测三类任务。
en_tdlr: HyBrain summarizes spatiotemporal EEG evidence via a small set of soft hyperedges instead of pairwise channel edges, enabling a single encoder to perform window-based seizure detection, per-second point-wise detection, and preictal seizure prediction.
